latest.title: GCS-based triage misses seriously injured trauma patients
latest.finding: GCS 3–8 detected diagnosis-based severe injury with 54.2% sensitivity (κ 0.192); one in ten patients (10.0%) met the anatomical severity criterion despite GCS 9–15; destination undertriage was 33.6% (GCS-based) and 47.3% (ICISS-based), with rural disparity (aOR 2.65 and 2.04).

latest.title: Rhythm changes during CPR track neurological outcomes
latest.finding: Weighted good-neurological-outcome risks were 0.101% (asystole–asystole), 0.231% (asystole→PEA), 0.384% (PEA→asystole) and 0.874% (PEA–PEA); versus persistent asystole, asystole→PEA OR 2.28 (95% CI 1.78–2.93) and PEA–PEA OR 8.70 (95% CI 6.98–10.83).

latest.title: Higher admission PaCO2 linked to worse post-arrest survival
latest.finding: One-month mortality was 73.6% overall and rose across PaCO2 groups (49.7%, 81.1% and 90.7% for ≤50, >50–70 and >70 mmHg); each 10-mmHg increase carried aOR 1.45 (95% CI 1.24–1.70) for mortality, with a matching gradient for neurological outcome (common aOR 1.53).
